services.desc: Yoga from the Heart’s 200-Hour Teacher Training has been designed for serious students who want to deepen their practice and for those who feel called to teach with clarity, safety, and integrity. We are not currently enrolling a 200-hour teacher training cohort. However, this foundational program remains part of the history and heart of our studio, and we continue to welcome inquiries from students who are interested in future training ordeeper study. Our approach is grounded in alignment, anatomy, functional movement, breath awareness, philosophy, restorative practice, and the art of teaching students as individuals. services.desc: Teaching has always been at the heart of Yoga from the Heart. As Sarasota’s first Yoga Alliance Registered Yoga School, we have spent more than 25 years helping students and teachers deepen their understanding of yoga through thoughtful practice, anatomy, alignment, sequencing, philosophy, and mentorship. While we are not currently enrolling a new teacher training group, this work remains an important part of who we are. We welcome inquiries from students and teachers interested in future teacher training, advanced study, continuing education, or one-on-one mentorship with Lynn.
